The task was completed successfully.

The child initially struggled with how to access the kibble, incorrectly attempting to use the cabinet to open the pantry door, and needed clarification that the pantry could be opened directly. The caregiver guided the child to open the pantry, then use a spoon to scoop kibble from the opened bag into the bowl, which the child successfully completed.
